mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances (i.e., returns are positive in >55% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high industrial production growth, a slowdown in manufacturing output (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO slowdowns (3-month decline) produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential construction permits (HOUST) relative to historical averages indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals rising inflation pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a stagnant federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals that the Federal Reserve is not responding to labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced confidence in economic policy.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE > 6.5% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances (i.e., returns are positive in >55% of such periods).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average.
